# The order of one tick's inbound packets. A chat command is handled on the network thread and its server task runs before the
# main thread drains the packets of the batch, so the marker that `!send` puts after a packet answers before the packet's own
# reply: a `test_instance_block_status` answer lands in the window after the marker's segment, and only `reply` (which waits for
# it before sending the marker) puts it in the segment of the `!send` line.
#   scripts/command-diff.sh crates/mc-game/tests/fixtures/commands_corpus/packet_order.txt
!packets test_instance_block_status
setblock 10 -60 10 minecraft:test_instance_block

# ---- the answer comes after the marker
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 init
!ticks 3 show
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 query
!ticks 3 show

# ---- `reply` waits for the answer: it is in the segment of the packet
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 init reply
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 query reply

# ---- a packet that sends nothing back leaves the segment empty
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 11 -60 10 query
!ticks 3 show
